key: milli-log-loss; positive = the second-named forecast has the lower log loss (better); a 95% interval that spans 0 is a tie
population_rule: excl_debut leaves out matches with a player whose first Stage 0 match is in the match's season (audit B1); 'all' is the sensitivity

mde.rule: SE of base_s0 vs primary_s0 on the pilot (2019-2021, scored population), x sqrt(pilot matches / confirmation matches), x (z 0.975 + z 0.80) = MDE at 80% power, two-sided 5%; conservative (single seeds)
